title_zh: 从童年收藏中挑选时间胶囊纪念品

scenario.label_zh: 选择家庭时间胶囊的物品
scenario.goal_zh: 选定可放入时间胶囊的童年纪念品，并确认埋藏位置和记录方式

context_zh: 兄妹整理自家收藏，准备在获准使用的花坛位置放置一个时间胶囊。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: What should we put in the box before we bury it?

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Something from our childhood, not just a note saying what day it is.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: I could add this coin from our first trip abroad.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Is that the special one from your collection? You might want to keep it.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: I have two the same. I will use the spare and keep the rest of the collection here.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Then I will add a copy of our school photo, not the original.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: Good. Mum said we can use the empty corner of the flower bed.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Let us mark that spot on a drawing too, so we can find the box in ten years.
